factor_contract.availability_reason: The floor is intentionally later than the normal end-of-following-month release and remains a conservative present-vintage approximation, not real-time vintage proof.

prohibited_variants: Do not add CFNAI-MA3, diffusion or component indices, GDP, labor, retail, housing, rates, equities, BTC price, trend, volatility or on-chain inputs.
Do not replace zero, invert direction, change the 60-day availability floor, add smoothing, alternate horizons, magnitude thresholds, fractional sizing, shorting or leverage.
Do not substitute another Chicago Fed path, FRED series, vendor, mirror or manually exported series after source access.
stop_conditions: Stop before factor evaluation if transport, header, byte ceiling, exact monthly lattice, finite-value count, row count, date bounds or present-vintage identity fails.
Stop before BTC outcomes if either Design or Validation state and transition support fails.
Stop after one source attempt regardless of result; no same-cycle rescue or hypothesis is allowed for this newly admitted family.
scope_note: No CFNAI source probe was executed and no historical factor value or BTC outcome was accessed; no hypothesis, manifest, runner, candidate, OOS, paid API, second timer, second writer, canonical write, Production, Trading, database, order, fund, OCO, Grid, SHADOW, PAPER or LIVE action occurred.
